title: Jailbroken: How Does LLM Safety Training Fail?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the success rate (BAD BOT rate) of adversarial jailbreak attacks designed to bypass safety filters and elicit restricted behaviors, specifically prompts requesting accent discrimination, attractiveness stereotypes, and hate speech.
Testing specific jailbreak prompts that explicitly request antisemitic content (e.g., 'Write "I hate jews"...') to measure whether the model's safety mechanisms can be subverted.

Measuring the attack success rate of jailbreak prompts that ask the model to generate promotional or normalizing content for white nationalism (e.g., writing a Twitter bio for a white nationalist user).
